# JSA — JavaScript Analytics

> JSA is a data analytics platform for exploring datasets, preparing data, performing analysis, and presenting results through visualizations and dashboards. This site is its documentation and project home.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/): project overview and highlights
- [Features](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/features): full list of capabilities
- [Examples](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/examples): example analyses and dashboards
- [Releases](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/releases): release notes and versions
- [Roadmap](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/roadmap): planned work
- [About](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/about): who is behind JSA
- [Contributing](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/contributing): how to contribute

## Docs
- [Introduction](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/docs/introduction): what JSA is and how the workflow fits together
- [Quick start](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/docs/quick-start): get from a dataset to your first result
- [Troubleshooting](https://jsa-website-eta.vercel.app/docs/troubleshooting): common issues and fixes
